hyperion._comment: First-party, read-only: doctor + project-verify tools. No package to install. If the kit lives in a subfolder (e.g. Hyperion/), add it to the path. See .github/mcp/README.md.

jira._comment: Official Atlassian Rovo MCP server (Jira + Confluence). Sign in with OAuth on first use; no token in this file.

linear._comment: Official Linear MCP server, read-only. Use https://mcp.linear.app/mcp for read-write. OAuth on first use.

gitlab._comment: Official GitLab MCP server (GitLab 18.3+). Self-managed: https://<your-gitlab>/api/v4/mcp. OAuth on first use.

azure-devops._comment: Official Microsoft server (github.com/microsoft/azure-devops-mcp). Replace <your-organization-name> literally; it's a CLI arg, not an env var. Auths via Azure CLI (`az login`). Pin a reviewed version (@azure-devops/mcp@x.y.z) for teams.
